full_prompt_en: A square misty landscape photograph shows a solitary figure standing on a thin shoreline beside broad, still water. The upper half is nearly empty pale blue-gray fog, with no distinct sky boundary. At the far right, a mass of dark conifer trees rises from the shore, its upper tips still legible while trunks and lower edges dissolve into the low mist. A horizontal strip of dark wet sand or shallow bank crosses the middle of the frame, separating the pale distance from the reflective foreground. The person stands small near the center, upright and facing into the fog. Details of clothing and face are lost at that distance; the figure reads as a narrow dark silhouette and a short reflection immediately below. The water across the lower half is calm but not perfectly uniform. Shallow ripples, muted patches of sand, and tiny scattered marks interrupt the reflection of sky and tree line. The forest's reflected dark mass gathers at the lower right, counterbalancing its real silhouette above. Farther left, open water and fog blend with almost no visible landmark. The color palette stays tightly within cold slate, blue-gray, and deep charcoal, with no warm focal light. Illumination is broad and diffused through the fog, flattening shadows and gradually reducing contrast with distance. The nearest water surface holds slightly more texture than the hazy bank, creating gentle depth without a strong perspective line. The overall composition is spare and introspective, with the tiny upright mark and paired forest silhouettes giving scale to a vast, quiet field of mist.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形雾景风光照片描绘一个孤独人物站在细窄岸线上，旁边是宽阔平静的水面。上半幅几乎全是空旷浅蓝灰雾气，没有清楚的天空边界。最右侧一团深暗针叶树从岸边升起，树梢仍能辨认，树干和下缘则溶入低雾。一条深色湿沙或浅滩横穿画面中部，将苍白远处与反光前景分开。人物在中央附近显得很小，直立并面向雾中。距离使衣着和面孔细节消失；人影是一道狭窄深色剪影，身下紧跟着短倒影。下半幅水面平静，却并非完全均匀。浅波纹、低饱和沙斑和细小散点打断天空与树线倒影。林子的反射深色团块聚在右下，与上方真实剪影平衡。更左边开阔水面和雾几乎没有可见地标地交融。色盘紧紧限制在冷石板色、蓝灰和深炭灰，没有暖色焦点光。照明穿过雾气宽泛漫射，使影子趋平，并随距离逐渐降低反差。最近的水面比朦胧岸边有稍多纹理，形成温和纵深，而无强烈透视线。整体构图简省而内省，以小小竖向记号和上下成对的树林剪影，给浩瀚安静雾域提供尺度。
style_prompt_en: A misty photographic treatment relies on near-monochromatic blue-gray, slate, and charcoal, with broad pale areas left almost featureless. Dense fog lowers contrast by distance, dissolving edges from firm nearby silhouettes into vague tonal masses. A narrow dark horizontal division can anchor a large open upper field above a calmer reflective lower field. The reflection repeats important masses with reduced clarity, adding a restrained visual symmetry. One small high-contrast mark gives scale without filling the emptiness. Light is diffuse from every direction, so shadows are soft and local rather than cast across the frame. Fine texture belongs mainly to the close lower surface; the distant field remains smooth and quiet. The overall effect is cool, spacious, and contemplative, with negative space and gradual edge loss as its strongest visual traits.
style_prompt_zh: 雾景摄影处理依靠近单色的蓝灰、石板色和炭灰，大块浅色区域几乎不留特征。浓雾随距离压低反差，使边缘从近处坚实剪影逐渐融为模糊明度团块。细窄深色水平分界可以锚住上方广阔开阔区域与下方更平静的反光区域。倒影以降低的清晰度重复重要量块，增加克制的视觉对称。一个小小高反差记号提供尺度，却不填满空白。光线从各方向漫射，影子柔软且局部，而非横穿画框的投影。细肌理主要属于下方近处表面，远处色域平滑安静。整体冷静、宽敞而沉思，负空间与渐失边缘是最强的视觉特征。
theme_en: A solitary figure at a quiet water's edge beside a mist-shrouded forest
theme_zh: 一个孤独人物站在宁静水边，旁边树林被浓雾包围
name: Misty
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
